name: Stream Deck Host
description: Run Elgato Stream Deck plugins and profiles on the panel — real *.sdPlugin packages, plus .streamDeckProfile imports with working Hotkey/Text/Open keys.

options.label: Plugins folder
options.help: Folder on this PC holding your *.sdPlugin packages and any *.streamDeckProfile files to import (Profile button → Import). Plugins are real programs that run on your PC — only add plugins you trust.

options.label: Key size
options.help: Keys are square; how many columns fit is worked out from the screen automatically. Tip: enable the Buttons strip below to split the panel — Bedrock Panel tiles on one side, the deck on the other.
